description: Return one MCP App card of the worst restaurants in chicago, nyc, minneapolis, milwaukee, austin, or denver. Pass limit 500. One call is enough. Use this for a bad or nasty place in a city. Do not page, and do not quote inspector comments.

city.description: City to query: chicago, nyc, minneapolis, milwaukee, austin, or denver.

limit.description: Number of records per request (1-500). Use 500 to get maximum data per call for large datasets.

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination. Pass the previous response's next_offset to get the next page. Default 0.

name: get_city_inspections
